```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(df: pd.DataFrame):
    # Keep only numeric columns
    numeric_df = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).copy()

    # Prepare empty fallback result/plot
    empty_result = pd.DataFrame(
        columns=["principal component 1", "principal component 2"]
    )
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    # If there are not enough numeric columns or rows, return empty outputs
    if numeric_df.shape[0] == 0 or numeric_df.shape[1] < 2:
        ax.set_xlabel("principal component")
        ax.set_ylabel("principal component 2")
        return empty_result, ax

    # Impute missing values with column means; if a column is all NaN, use 0
    for col in numeric_df.columns:
        col_mean = numeric_df[col].mean()
        if pd.isna(col_mean):
            col_mean = 0.0
        numeric_df[col] = numeric_df[col].fillna(col_mean)

    # PCA needs at least 2 samples to produce 2 components meaningfully
    if numeric_df.shape[0] < 2:
        ax.set_xlabel("principal component")
        ax.set_ylabel("principal component 2")
        return empty_result, ax

    # Run PCA
    pca = PCA(n_components=2)
    components = pca.fit_transform(numeric_df)

    result_df = pd.DataFrame(
        components,
        columns=["principal component 1", "principal component 2"],
        index=df.index,
    )

    # Scatter plot
    sns.scatterplot(
        x="principal component 1",
        y="principal component 2",
        data=result_df,
        ax=ax,
    )
    ax.set_xlabel("principal component")
    ax.set_ylabel("principal component 2")

    return result_df, ax
```
